Physics (PHYS)

PHYS 1101 General Physics I Lab

Laboratory course taken alongside the lecture. Experiments cover measurement method, data collection and error analysis.

PHYS 1102 General Physics II Lab

A continuation of the first laboratory course, covering electricity, magnetism and optics.

PHYS 2125 University Physics I

Mechanics, wave motion and thermodynamics for students in engineering and the physical sciences.

This description is published by the college for the current catalog and is reviewed each year by the academic department that offers it. Students should speak with an advisor before registering, since availability varies by term and by campus.
